title: WF-04 JD-Candidate Matching — Results Payload
description: The payload that WF-04 produces. The score is DECOMPOSED: each component is judged and evidenced independently, and overall_score is computed arithmetically in application code from the component weights - never returned as a single opaque number by the model. This is what makes a rejection explainable and defensible.

overall_score.description: COMPUTED IN CODE as the sum of components[].weighted_score. Must not be produced by the model. Business rule BV-04 requires component weights to sum to 1.0; enforce that in the validator, since JSON Schema cannot express arithmetic.

recommendation.description: Banded from overall_score using thresholds in organization config. Advisory only - never an automated rejection. Final decisions are human (Workflow_Spec.md section 15).

components.description: One entry per scoring dimension. Adding a dimension means adding an entry here and a weight in 'weighting' - the arithmetic does not change.

component_id.description: Extend this enum when adding a dimension, so unknown components fail validation rather than being silently ignored.

raw_score.description: This dimension judged on its own merits, independent of the others.

rationale.description: Why this score. Must reference the evidence, not restate the number.

weighting.description: Which rubric produced this score. Recorded per result so a historical match stays reproducible after the rubric changes.

weights.description: Loaded from config/organization.yaml, not hardcoded. Must sum to 1.0 (BV-04).

must_have_requirements.description: Every must-have from the JD, individually resolved. UNKNOWN is distinct from NOT_MET - absence of evidence is not evidence of absence, and conflating them silently rejects candidates.

gaps.description: What the candidate is missing, for the recruiter and for candidate feedback.

auto_archive_eligible.description: True when overall_score < 0.40 (BR-04). Eligibility only - archiving still requires the configured recruiter path, and an override requires written justification recorded in the audit log.

excluded_signals.description: Protected or proxy attributes deliberately excluded from scoring - name, gender, age, nationality, university prestige, address. The Phase 4.2 bias harness perturbs exactly these and asserts overall_score does not move.
